slot.brief: Give an unsymmetrical internal alkene and ask the two carbonyl fragments formed on ozonolysis (reductive work-up).

stem: Reductive ozonolysis of 2-methylpent-2-ene gives which pair of carbonyl products?

verdicts.working: Cleavage of the C2=C3 bond gives propan-2-one from C2 (two methyl groups) and propanal from C3 (H and ethyl group).

working:
2-methylpent-2-ene is CH3-C(CH3)=CH-CH2-CH3. Reductive ozonolysis cleaves the C=C and adds one oxygen to each double-bonded carbon. The disubstituted carbon becomes (CH3)2CO, propan-2-one. The CH carbon becomes CH3CH2CHO, propanal.

Independent check: Cleavage of the C2=C3 bond gives propan-2-one from C2 (two methyl groups) and propanal from C3 (H and ethyl group).
solution: Reductive ozonolysis cleaves the C=C bond, converting each alkene carbon into a carbonyl carbon.\n$$\mathrm{CH_3C(CH_3)=CHCH_2CH_3 \longrightarrow (CH_3)_2CO + CH_3CH_2CHO}$$\nThe products are propan-2-one and propanal.
